title: Cycle 18: Cross-Provider Failover
weak_spots: In-provider model failover could not escape a fully unhealthy provider
Predictive selection had no key-gated provider eligibility check
Per-provider/baseURL/model reliability history was not reused across provider boundaries
Models tab exposed no cross-provider reachability or failover toggle
Chat retry only switched models, never providers

gates.swift test: skipped (XCTest not available in CommandLineTools toolchain)

next_options.name: Adaptive parallel provider warmup
next_options.summary: Send tiny probe requests to all eligible providers in parallel and route the live chat to whichever returns the lowest TTFT, not just the highest composite score.

next_options.name: Provider-specific circuit breaker and budget awareness
next_options.summary: Add per-provider failure counters and account-balance gates so failover avoids providers that are rate-limited, out of quota, or recently auth-failed.

next_options.name: User-defined provider preference order
next_options.summary: Expose a drag-to-rank provider list in the Models tab so cross-provider ranking can blend learned reliability with explicit user priority.

notes: Cross-provider ranking reuses the Cycle 17 composite reliability × latency score, preserving per-endpoint history keys.
Failover is one-shot per chat send: on success the new provider stays active; on failure the original selection is restored.
Models tab toggle, manual probe button, and provider reachability rows give users visibility and control.
New XCTest coverage targets ranking, eligibility, health probes, restore, and toggle persistence; full execution requires an Xcode toolchain.
